title: Can I DOMINATE Drawback Chess?
summary: Drawback Chess vs online humans on the Drawback site; goal: win five games. Each player has a random secret drawback (e.g. Savior Complex: when in check you must move your queen or lose; Indecisive; Lame Duck: can't move your king; True Gentleman: can't capture a queen; Scouting Ahead: while you have a pawn you cannot move non-pawns ahead of your most advanced pawn). Kings can be captured; flagging counts.
rules: Standard setup; each side dealt one secret drawback (Easy-Hard slider shown); opponent's revealed after game.
Kings may be captured; moving into check is legal.

Drawbacks seen: Savior Complex (when in check, you must move your queen or lose); Indecisive (your pieces can't capture if ... - text truncated); Lame Duck (you can't move your king); True Gentleman (never capture a queen); Scouting Ahead (as long as you have a pawn, you cannot move non-pawns ahead of your most advanced pawn).
win_condition: Capture the enemy king, opponent loses via drawback, or on time. Goal: 5 wins.

board.theme_notes: Drawback site cream/brown board on purple UI; drawback card with Easy-Hard slider; chessreps sponsor segment.

events: Drawback card at start; opponent drawback reveal at end
